AccountInviteIn.description: Invite an adult by email. They choose their own password from the emailed link.
AccountInviteIn.title: AccountInviteIn

AdminAccountOut.description: A host or admin as other admins see it. Never carries a password, hash or link.
AdminAccountOut.title: AdminAccountOut

BallotIn.description:
One person's ballot, replacing any earlier one. Ranks run 1..m with no gaps,
m <= the night's ballot_size. top3: rank 1 alone is fine. pick_one: one option at
rank 1. approval: the approved options numbered 1..m; that order means nothing
(ADR-0010). An empty ballot is never valid.
BallotIn.title: BallotIn

BulkAddIn.description: Typed titles, one per line in the UI ("Title (year)" parsed client-side).
BulkAddIn.title: BulkAddIn

BulkPickIn.description:
An answer for an ambiguous or not-found line: `tmdb_id` to use that TMDB title, or
leave it out to add the title as typed (no TMDB id).
BulkPickIn.title: BulkPickIn

ClaimIn.description:
Claim a person for this phone or switch to them (ADR-0014). `pin` is their PIN, or
the new one on a first claim. Leave it out to ask a host to approve instead.
ClaimIn.title: ClaimIn

ConsentIn.description: The versions the page showed; a stale page is 422. Admins must set `guardian`.
ConsentIn.title: ConsentIn

ConsentOut.description:
ADR-0017 §2. `account_accepted` false: show the consent screen to this account.
`household_accepted` false: new people, phones and photos are refused (409
`consent_required`) until an admin accepts.
ConsentOut.title: ConsentOut

GenerateIn.description:
Roll candidates without adding them. Omit `age_cap` to use the night's cap (else the
household default); send `age_cap: null` for no cap tonight.
GenerateIn.title: GenerateIn

HelpCountOut.description: The TV's "waiting for the host" nudge (G4): pending person claims only.
HelpCountOut.title: HelpCountOut

HouseholdDeletionIn.description: The requesting admin's own password, and the household's name typed out.
HouseholdDeletionIn.title: HouseholdDeletionIn

JoinLinkOut.description:
What the TV needs to draw its join QR: `/j/{join_slug}`, plus `?code={code}` when
`qr_includes_night_code` is on. The night code is never here: the server only keeps its
hash (ADR-0002), and the TV already holds the plaintext from create/rotate.
JoinLinkOut.title: JoinLinkOut

MergeOut.description: What moved. `dropped_*` rows collided with the target's own and were discarded.
MergeOut.title: MergeOut

MovieFlagsIn.description: Only the flags sent are changed.
MovieFlagsIn.title: MovieFlagsIn

OptionIn.description:
Exactly one of: a movie already in the library, a TMDB id (upserts the library row),
or a typed title (for when TMDB is off or doesn't have it).
OptionIn.title: OptionIn

PasswordIn.description: Required when the account already has a password.
PasswordIn.title: PasswordIn

PersonDeletedOut.description: ADR-0017 §4: what went with the person (anyone merged into them went too).
PersonDeletedOut.title: PersonDeletedOut

PersonUpdateIn.description: Only the fields sent are changed.
PersonUpdateIn.title: PersonUpdateIn

person_id.description: Who is sharing it: a person bound to this device
person_id.title: Person Id

taken_on.description: EXIF DateTimeOriginal, date only (read on the phone)
taken_on.title: Taken On

expires_in.description: Seconds the upload URLs stay valid
expires_in.title: Expires In

thumb_upload_url.description: PUT the thumbnail JPEG here, same content type
thumb_upload_url.title: Thumb Upload Url

upload_url.description: PUT the full JPEG here with Content-Type: image/jpeg
upload_url.title: Upload Url

my_reactions.description: Reactions by people bound to the calling device (empty for accounts)
my_reactions.title: My Reactions

thumb_url.description: Presigned GET for the thumbnail (10 min)
thumb_url.title: Thumb Url

url.description: Presigned GET for the full image (10 min)
url.title: Url

PinErrorOut.description: 403 wrong PIN (counted), 423 locked. Same envelope as every error, plus attempts_left.
PinErrorOut.title: PinErrorOut

PinResetOut.description: A "forgot PIN" request. Approving clears the PIN; no PIN is ever shown or chosen.
PinResetOut.title: PinResetOut

PlatformDisableIn.description: Why, in words the household's admins are emailed.
PlatformDisableIn.title: PlatformDisableIn

PlatformMeOut.description: The operator, and the household they're inside, if any.
PlatformMeOut.title: PlatformMeOut

PresenceOut.description:
Who's here tonight (G8): people a phone set to them opened the night or voted for,
plus anyone with a ballot. Family first, then guests.
PresenceOut.title: PresenceOut

RatingIn.description: One person's score for the night's movie, replacing any earlier one.
RatingIn.title: RatingIn

RatingSummaryOut.description: The family's average only: never anyone's own score.
RatingSummaryOut.title: RatingSummaryOut

SelfCreateIn.description: A new guest profile for whoever holds this phone; the PIN is set in the same call.
SelfCreateIn.title: SelfCreateIn

SessionUpdateIn.description: Draft-only changes (ADR-0010): the method locks with the shortlist.
SessionUpdateIn.title: SessionUpdateIn

SettingsUpdateIn.description: Only the fields sent are changed; `default_age_cap: null` clears the cap.
SettingsUpdateIn.title: SettingsUpdateIn

SlideshowIn.description: Start (`true`) or stop (`false`) the paired TV's slideshow (issue #41).
SlideshowIn.title: SlideshowIn

UpdateSelfIn.description:
Change your own name and/or picture; only the fields sent change, at least one.
The name changes once (ADR-0014); the picture any number of times.
UpdateSelfIn.title: UpdateSelfIn

VerifyIn.description: Forgot password (ADR-0014): the emailed link sets a new password and signs in.
VerifyIn.title: VerifyIn

VotersOut.description: Who has voted, for the TV's avatar tiles. Never what they ranked.
VotersOut.title: VotersOut

schema.title: Response List Claims Api V1 Devices Claims Get

post.description:
Let this browser in on the signed-in host's authority. With `as_tv`, the device is
marked as the TV and the host session is cleared from this browser, so a TV left in the
living room never holds host rights. With `keep_session` as well (the host's own laptop
driving the TV from a second window), the session stays: the two cookies have different
names and the TV screens send the device-only header, so neither clobbers the other.

get.description:
How many phones are waiting for a host to OK a person claim, and who the oldest one
is for. The TV only. PIN resets are admin-only and never counted here.

The household's join slug and whether the QR should carry the night code, for the
TV (`is_tv` device) or a signed-in host (`sessions:run`). Phones get 403: the slug is on
the fridge anyway, but there is no reason to hand it out.
